name: Capacitive touch button (TTP223 module)
description: One-key capacitive touch pad: touching the pad sets I/O HIGH (a push-pull output, no pull-up needed). VCC to 3.3 V or 5 V, GND to GND, I/O to any digital pin read with digitalRead. The A and B solder jumpers (props output, mode) make it active-low or a toggle.

pins.label: I/O
pins.description: Output: HIGH while touched (default), push-pull at the VCC level.

props.label: Mode (jumper B)

options.label: Toggle (B bridged): each touch flips the output

props.description: Momentary follows the finger; toggle latches on each touch.

footprint: 24 × 15 mm module, 3-pin 0.1 in header (I/O VCC GND), touch pad on the front

bindings.description: A finger is on the pad.
The output is in its active state (touched, or latched on in toggle mode).
Highlight of the pad while touched (0 or 1).
